cross_check_movement_optimizer.model_difference_explanation: Movement Optimizer is a planar rigid-body estimate (gravity and torso inertia, no muscles); OpenSim is a 3D JointReaction with no trunk muscles. Rotated into the torso frame with matched m_above (136.50 kg), the residual is 379.93 N compression (max |439.34| N) and -396.77 N AP shear (max |466.98| N) against the 50.0 N tolerance. The residual is not yet decomposed into its sources (pelvis acceleration, 3D coupling, contact).
